title.description: Write this first. A short title for the meeting, in your own words.

decisions.description: What was agreed, one short sentence each.

action_items.description: Who will do what: who is exactly "you" (on a call), exactly one name from <guests> (linked), a name the transcript gives (not linked) or exactly "unnamed" (in person or not linked, when the words name nobody).

due.description: YYYY-MM-DD when one is named, else "".

open_questions.description: What was asked but not settled.

follow_ups.description: Linked to the calendar: short email drafts from the owner, each to exactly one name from <guests>. Not linked: plain follow-ups (to = who, subject = what, body = ""). Usually none.

body.description: A draft's text; "" for a plain follow-up (not linked).

memory_suggestions.description: Lasting facts worth keeping in the owner's notes; usually none.
